_about: LOCAL STAND-IN until decisionlab publishes the backend contract fixture. The desktop UI reads every preset word from the PC; this file only lets node tests exercise the generic list, the being-prepared row and the one action without a backend. Replace it with the real fixture when the backend branch lands; do not treat these five sample rows as the contract.

presets.name: General
presets.description: Everyday questions, notes, email and the ordinary things you ask Jarvis to do.
presets.worse_at: Long coding jobs and very large documents.

presets.name: Coding
presets.description: Writing, reading and changing code on this PC.
presets.cost: A slower start; one model swap if the coding lane is not loaded.
presets.worse_at: Quick chat while the coding model is loading.

presets.name: Agentic + Vision
presets.description: Plans with several steps and looking at pictures or screens.
presets.cost: Uses the second card; a picture look takes longer than text.

presets.name: Fast
presets.description: The quickest lane for short questions and short answers.
presets.cost: Fast, with less room for a long conversation.

presets.name: General Uncensored
presets.description: General questions with the unfiltered everyday model.
presets.status_words: General Uncensored is being prepared: the model is being installed and measured.

one_card: Choosing a preset raises one approval card on the PC. Nothing switches until you answer it, and the phone shows the same card.
note: Fast is the quick lane on the 2080 SUPER with qwen3:8b; the PC's own rows say what each preset uses.
